ChatPopupSeconds.Name: Chat pop-up duration (seconds)
ChatPopupSeconds.Hint: How long a new chat card stays on screen as a pop-up while the chat sidebar is closed. Foundry's default is 5. Applies to you only. Foundry V13 and later.

SheetPdfPath.Name: Blank character sheet PDF
SheetPdfPath.Hint: Your copy of the blank fillable character sheet (TBE_RPG_Character_Sheet_BW_Fillable_v13). Upload it anywhere in your Data folder and pick it here; TBE: Sheet Exchange then fills it without asking.

LinkCharacters.Name: Link Character tokens to their actor
LinkCharacters.Hint: A Character's token shows and changes the actor in the sidebar, instead of carrying its own private copy. Without this, work done with the token selected (building the character, damage, spending Resolve) lands in the token and looks lost when the token is later linked. Creatures are never linked.

CharacterVision.Name: Character tokens have vision
CharacterVision.Hint: New Character tokens start with vision enabled.

LockRotation.Name: Lock token rotation
LockRotation.Hint: Every new token has rotation locked, and on the first load with this setting every existing actor and placed token is locked too.

SceneVision.Name: New scenes use token vision
SceneVision.Hint: New scenes start with Token Vision on.

OracleEvents.Name: Random Events use imported oracle tables
OracleEvents.Hint: When on, Random Event, Ask the Weave and Subverted Scene roll the event focus and word pair on the oracle tables you imported with TBE: Import Oracle Tables. Any it cannot find fall back to the TBE tables.

PortraitFolders.Name: Portrait folders
PortraitFolders.Hint: Folders of images in your Data folder to roll portraits from, for Create Character, TBE: NPC and TBE: Funnel. Each subfolder is a collection you can roll within. Several folders: separate them with ;
